guitar.notes: Fogerty used several guitars over CCR's career (Rickenbacker, Les Paul, Kustom K200); no single fully dominant model, medium confidence is appropriate.

tone.target: clean-to-edge-of-breakup swamp pop strum with bright jangle
tone.profile: clean-to-edge-of-breakup swamp pop strum with bright jangle
tone.summary: A clean, bright signal chain using light compression and a Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) with minimal reverb to capture the dry, jangling swamp pop sound of CCR.
corrections: replace blues-rock crunch with cleaner CCR jangle
